name: $youtubeDownload
description: Downloads a YouTube video and saves it to the given file path.

args.name: videoID
args.description: The ID of the YouTube video

args.name: filePath
args.description: Where to save the downloaded file

args.name: playlistId
args.description: YouTube playlist ID

args.name: limit
args.description: Maximum number of items to return

name: $getMusicLyrics
description: Fetches lyrics for a YouTube Music track (video ID)

args.name: videoId
args.description: YouTube Music video ID

name: $getVideoCaptions
description: Returns the available captions/subtitles for a YouTube video by its ID.

args.name: videoID
args.description: The ID of the YouTube video

name: $getComments
description: Fetches top-level comments for a video

args.name: videoId
args.description: YouTube video ID

args.name: limit
args.description: Number of comments to return

name: $getVideoEngagement
description: Returns basic engagement stats for a YouTube video (views, likes, comments)

args.name: videoId
args.description: YouTube video ID

name: $getVideoStats
description: Returns views, likes, comments count for a video

args.name: videoID
args.description: The ID of the YouTube video

name: $youtubeChannelSearch
description: Searches YouTube and returns the top channels in JSON format.

args.name: query
args.description: The search query to look up on YouTube

args.name: limit
args.description: Number of channels to return (default 5)

args.name: sortBy
args.description: Sort results by: relevance, rating, upload_date, view_count

name: $ytMusicSearch
description: Searches YouTube Music and returns top songs.

args.name: query
args.description: Query to search on YouTube Music

args.name: limit
args.description: Number of songs to return (default 5)

name: $youtubePlaylistSearch
description: Searches YouTube and returns the top playlists in JSON format. Supports filters.

args.name: query
args.description: The search query to look up on YouTube

args.name: limit
args.description: Number of playlists to return (default: 5)

args.name: uploadDate
args.description: Upload date filter: all, hour, today, week, month, year

args.name: duration
args.description: Video duration filter: all, short, medium, long

args.name: sortBy
args.description: Sort results by: relevance, rating, upload_date, view_count

args.name: features
args.description: Comma-separated features: hd, subtitles, 4k, live, etc.

name: $youtubeVideoSearch
description: Searches YouTube and returns the top videos in JSON format with execution time. Supports filters.

args.name: query
args.description: The search query to look up on YouTube

args.name: limit
args.description: Maximum number of videos to return (default 5, max 25)

args.name: uploadDate
args.description: Upload date filter: all, hour, today, week, month, year

args.name: duration
args.description: Video duration filter: all, short, medium, long

args.name: sortBy
args.description: Sort results by: relevance, rating, upload_date, view_count

args.name: features
args.description: Comma-separated features: hd, subtitles, 4k, live, etc.
